page.layout: Two parallel columns of a Hebrew lexicon, left column then right column. Running head at the top of each column (י מ). Page number 161 at the top right. Catchword at the foot of the right column. Signature mark at the foot of the right column.

main_text.l: יִמִּינַת [?] dextera, fæm. ג
No. Rad. יָמִין.
יִמָּנַע cohibebitur, וַיִּמָּנְעוּ & cohibiti sunt, fut. Niph. 3. f. & pl. m. Rad. מָנַע
יִמַּס liquescet, וַיִּמַּסוּ & dissoluta sunt, fut. Niph. 3. f. & pl. m. Rad. מָסַס
וַיִּמְסֵם & liquefecit ea, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. aff. Rad. מָסָה.
יִמָּסְרוּ & traditi sunt, fut. Niph. 3. pl. m. R. מָסַר
וַיִּמֵּן & expressit, (pro יִמְצָה,) fut. Kal, 3. f. m. apoc. Rad. מָצָה
יִמָּצֵא invenietur, יִמָּצְאוּ invenientur, fut. Niph. 3. f. & pl. m. Rad. מָצָא
יִמְצָאֶנָּה invenient eam, Jer.2.24. & יִמְצָאֻנִי me, pro יִמְצָאוּהָ, & יִמְצָאֻנִי, fut. Kal, 3. pl. m. aff. Rad. מָצָא
יִמָּצֶה exprimetur, fut. Niph. 3. f. m. & יִמָּצוּ exprimentur, 3. pl. m.
Rad. מָצָה.
יִמַּקּוּ tabescient, vel (pro eo) יִמַּק, fut. Niph. 3. pl. m. Rad. מָקַק.
יָמַר amarum erit, Jef.24. 9. (pro יִמַּר,) fut. Niph. 3. f. m. Rad. מָרַר.
יִמְרוּךָ dicent tibi, Pf.139. 20. pro יֹאמְרוּךָ, fut. Kal, 3. pl. m. aff. Rad. אָמַר.
יִמָּרֵט glabrum fiet, fut. Niph. 3. f. m. R. מָרַט.
וַיְמָרְרֵהוּ et amaritudine affecerunt eum, fut. Piel, 3. pl. m. aff. Rad. מָרַר.
וַיָּמָשׁ & amovebit, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. R. מוּשׁ.
יִמָּשְׁכוּ protrahentur, fut. Niph. 3. pl. m. Rad. מָשַׁךְ.
יִמְשֵׁנִי amovebit me, הוּ eum, יִמְשׁוּ amovebunt, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. aff. & 3. pl. m. Rad. מוּשׁ.
יִמְשָׁנִי extrahet me, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. aff. Rad. מָשָׁה.

page.notes: Ink specks and damage across both columns. The Hebrew vowel points on several entries are doubtful and are marked [?] where I could not read them with confidence. The headword at the start of the first left-column line is doubtful. The printed "Jef.24." and "Pf.139." are copied as printed. The leading "1" at the left edge is a stray mark, not a printed number. The running head and signature are read from the faint header and foot marks and may be incomplete.
